s.note: the one Paddington keeps under his hat
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 60g soft butter and a thick layer of orange marmalade, about 200g in total. Sandwich together, keep the crusts on as Paddington would, and cut into squares.

Boil 800g potatoes, mash smooth with the juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp ají amarillo paste, 3 tbsp oil and salt. Mix 300g cooked shredded chicken breast with 3 tbsp mayonnaise. Layer potato, chicken, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.

m.how: Bake 500g frozen fries until crisp. Sear 600g sliced beef rump in a smoking wok, add 1 sliced red onion and 2 tomatoes in wedges, then 3 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp vinegar. Toss through the chips and serve with 300g cooked rice.

w.how: Beat 150g butter with 80g icing sugar, then mix in 150g cornflour and 100g flour. Roll 5mm thick, cut 24 rounds and bake at 170C for 10 minutes until pale. Sandwich in pairs with 300g dulce de leche and roll the edges in coconut.

d.how: Simmer 250g dried purple corn with the peel and core of 1 pineapple, 2 cinnamon sticks and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, stir in 100g sugar and the juice of 2 limes, and chill. Serve over ice.
